taxonomy.note: Kew/POWO accepts Vernonia lindheimeri; native range includes Texas, Arkansas, and northeastern Mexico.

evidence.detail: UT Austin Plant Resources Center Travis County Asteraceae herbarium index lists both Vernonia baldwinii and Vernonia lindheimeri.
UT Austin Plant Resources Center Vascular Plants of Williamson County search includes both Vernonia baldwinii and Vernonia lindheimeri.
Harvard GH specimen 01925980, A. A. Heller 1908, collected about Kerrville, Kerr County, determined Vernonia lindheimeri.

morphology.learner_core: Narrow-leaved purple ironweed; upper leaf surfaces usually glabrate rather than densely silky; dry rocky-site species.
morphology.refinement: FNA/WFO: linear cauline leaves about 5–8 cm × 2–4 mm, lower surfaces densely sericeo-tomentose, upper surfaces usually glabrate, margins strongly revolute; purple discoid heads in corymbiform arrays.
morphology.comparison: V. baldwinii is taller and much broader-leaved. V. × guadalupensis can show intermediate leaf width/hairiness and head traits.
